verdict.rationale: Cline explicitly markets no lock-in and the ability to self-host or switch providers/pricing anytime, which speaks to openness, but there is no direct documentation of an explicit 'export all your data' feature or open data formats (e.g., task history, chat logs) for users to take with them. missing for 10: explicit data-export feature, documented open storage/export format, evidence of exporting task/chat history.
